title: fix(studio,chatbot): no /layers 404 for draft-only items, no /ai/models request without an AI service (objectui#12508)
body:
Part of #12508
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Studio stops asking the server for things the console already knows are absent. No server change; existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys are unchanged.

- **Data pillar, object load** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `DataPillar`). The load used to read `client.layered('object', NAME)` beside the draft for every selected object. The rail's last read of the package's published list is now kept, and a name outside that list reads its draft first: with a draft served, `/layers` is skipped (the envelope it would have answered is the 404 one, every layer null, so `hasBaseline` and the projection are unchanged). With no draft served (a name published since the rail's read), `/layers` is still asked. A published name reads both at once, as before.
- **List-view buffer** (`ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`, `useObjectListViewDraft`). A view with no draft, of a **draft-only object**, skips `/layers`: nothing of that object is published, so no view of it has a layer. The Interfaces pillar's existing package read (published objects plus drafts) now also hands the buffer the draft-only names, stamped with the `publishNonce` they were read under. Only an answer read under the current publish counts, so the re-read right after a publish still asks.
- **`useAiModels`** (`packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAiModels.ts`). A 501 is remembered for the session (module state, keyed by URL): an empty picker, no error, no retry, and no request on a later mount or route change. Other failures keep the existing cold-boot retry.
- **Chat pane call site** (`AiChatPage.tsx`, `ChatPane`). `useAiModels` runs with `enabled: agents.length > 0`. The Studio copilot and the console dock mount the pane while the agent catalog is still loading. A server without `@objectstack/service-ai` answers that catalog with an empty list (measured: `GET /api/v1/ai/agents` 200 with `agents: []`) and `/ai/models` with 501. The catalog is an answer the console already reads, so no request was added.

## Deviations

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` is outside the claimed file surface. The claim allowed `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` / `index.tsx` "only if the hook's call site needs it". Measured: `ChatbotEnhanced` only documents the route, and the hook's one caller is `ChatPane` in app-shell. The change is the one `enabled` argument.
- A 404 is not remembered as "no AI service". The card says "a 501 (or 404)". The hook's own header documents a cold-boot 404/503 from the per-env kernel that the retry exists to wait out, so a remembered 404 could leave the picker empty for a whole session after one race. A 501 is the server's definitive answer.
- The leaf load in the Interfaces pillar (`client.layered(current.type, current.name)`) and `EmbeddedItemEditor` are unchanged. Neither asked anything in the card's session. The first already skips `/layers` for a leaf with a draft. The second reads layers only at save time, and only without a draft; its 404 is the path that refuses a save over a parent that does not exist.
- The list-view rule covers views of draft-only objects only. A published object whose default list view was never created still asks once and reads the 404 as "not created yet", as the objectui#11799 pins keep it. The shell cache's `listViews` is not a reliable "published" answer for that case (the 11799 suite's header says why).
- One 404 remains in the card's session, outside this PR's surface: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/st_ticket`, sent by the Interfaces canvas (`StudioObjectRecordsCanvas` in `studio-canvas-preview.tsx`). It renders the runtime `object-view`, whose `useSettledSchema` calls `getObjectSchema` for the draft-only object. Fixing it means deciding what the canvas shows for an unpublished object, so it is reported, not changed here. That is why the first line is `Part of`: acceptance 2 is not fully met.
- The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (1396 files) was not run locally: `views/studio-design/` alone hit the 560 s foreground cap. The suites that load the touched sites ran instead (listed below). CI runs the whole package.

## Before and after: the card's session

Backend: HotCRM `63db83e` under `objectstack dev --fresh` (no `@objectstack/service-ai`; discovery reports `services.ai` `enabled: false`). HotCRM's own package is read-only under `objectstack dev`, so a writable local package `com.default.studio-test` (namespace `st`) was created through `POST /api/v1/packages` before each run. Console: this worktree's `apps/console` vite dev server pointed at that backend. Driven by Playwright (Chromium 1482 × 1119): open the Data pillar, New object "Ticket" (saved as a draft, `st_ticket`), Interfaces pillar, Create app "Tickets" (opens the `st_ticket` entry, whose aside says the default list view does not exist yet), New page "Home". The log starts after sign-in. `sys_user_preference` filters are elided.

Before (objectui main `165f8ff`): three red lines, `object/st_ticket/layers`, `object/st_ticket` and `view/st_ticket.default/layers`. In this run both `/ai/models` requests were aborted when the empty catalog unmounted the pane. In an earlier run of the same session on the same main, the 501 landed (`GET /api/v1/ai/models → 501` between two aborted ones); whether it lands is a race between the two reads. A direct request answers 501 `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`.

## Test evidence (at `c7cda5d`)

New pins, each ablated once (mutation landed and verified on disk with `ablation-replace.mjs`, red observed, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- `DataPillar.draftOnlyNoLayers-12508.test.tsx`: a draft-only object sends no `/layers` and the editor holds its draft. CONTROLs: a drafts-list name whose draft is no longer served still reads `/layers`; a published object reads its layers; a 5xx on `/layers` surfaces as the pillar's refusal. Ablation (the draft-only branch disabled): red, `expected [ 404 ] to deeply equal []`.
- `ObjectListViewInspector.draftOnlyObject-12508.test.tsx`: a view absent from drafts and published, of a draft-only object, sends no `/layers` and reads "not created yet". CONTROLs: an answer read under an earlier publish is still asked; a published object's view reads its layer; a 5xx is still the buffer's load failure. Ablation: red, `expected [ 404 ] to deeply equal []`.
- `useAiModels.noAiService-12508.test.tsx`: a 501 is asked once, never retried, and not asked again on a remount. CONTROLs: a 503 is still retried; a 200 still fills the picker. Ablation (501 branch disabled): red, `called 1 times, but got 6 times`.
- `AiChatPage.modelsAfterCatalog-12508.test.tsx`: while the catalog is loading the model read is not enabled. CONTROL: with an agent it is enabled. Ablation (gate removed): both red (the control pins the exact options object).

Runs (repo-root vitest spelling, each through the shared verification lock):

- `packages/plugin-chatbot/`: 61 files, 626 tests passed.
- app-shell, the suites that load the touched sites: `DataPillar.*`, `InterfacesPillar.*`, `ObjectListViewInspector.*`, `AiChatPage.*`, the copilot and `ChatDock` suites (41 files, 194 tests); `StudioDesignSurface.*` in two halves (39 files, 193 tests; 39 files, 342 tests); every other test file naming `DataPillar`, `InterfacesPillar`, `useObjectListViewDraft`, `ObjectListViewInspector`, `useAiModels` or `ChatPane` (18 files, 177 tests). All passed.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0 (`tsconfig.test.json` lists all four new test files).
- `build` for both packages: exit 0 (app-shell dist completeness verified).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the touched files: 0 errors; the warning count in each touched source file equals its count on main.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots`: all exit 0.
